notes.title: Update 1.2 is Out Now!!!
notes.notes:
Attention Shoppers!

We have another major content update for you! This update adds a new game mode to multiplayer: Prop Hunt

-------------------------------
This new multiplayer mode splits players into two teams:

   -Shoppers:
Make it to checkout without going over budget AND not putting any Prop players in your cart 
OR
Destroy all the Prop players just like you would with normal items

   -Props:
Get a shopper to pick you up and put you in their cart without getting caught!
-------------------------------

This mode is available to all who have unlocked Multiplayer (by checking out on level 1 "Grocery Store" on any difficulty)

Thank you all and Happy Shopping!

notes.title: Update 1.1 is out Now!!!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42848145/ebdf55b773c8af7c6a04881933087203de3c565f.png

Attention Shoppers!

We have a major update for you! This update adds a new level to both single player and multiplayer titled "Supermarket".

In the spirit of Black Friday, this level takes place in a holiday-themed superstore, and everyone is rushing around to get the best deals. Don't stand still for too long!

This level will only be available in single player after you have successfully checked out on level 6 "Moon".

Thank you all and Happy Shopping!

notes.title: An Update on Playtesting
notes.notes:
Attention Shoppers!

The playtest that was originally scheduled for February 18-24, 2023 is being moved to March 4-10, 2023.

This playtest will be our first demo of multiplayer, and we want to make sure that everyone playing has a fun experience. The next upcoming playtest on January 21, 2023 will happen as originally planned.

As always, if you want to get involved with our early-build playtests, all you have to do is join our Discord. It's totally free!

Happy Shopping!
Fried Squid Games LLC

notes.title: The Official Shopping Spree: Extreme!!! Pre-release Roadmap
notes.notes:
Attention Shoppers!

The Official Pre-release roadmap for Shopping Spree: Extreme!!! is here! This showcases all of the major content being added to the game and displays the dates of our scheduled playtests!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42848145/c8c336d2e42292f717d5b967d4b84b4d57389784.png

In order to gain access to the playtests listed here, join our Discord server.

There's a long road ahead, and we're so happy to have you join along the way. During this time, we really need your help getting the community involved. Use this link to check out our other platforms, and share this link with your friends!

We will update this roadmap as we reach different milestones. Keep in mind, this is only showcasing what's happening up until the first release of this game. We have no plans of stopping after that!

Thank you all!
Sid & Tyler
Fried Squid Games LLC
